payload.detail: waiting: DEC-141: The premise is empty: no owner message is logged and no question is attached, so the record's claim that the owner answered on 2026-10-16 that all three behaviours stay cannot be checked against the owner's words. This doubt is about what the owner actually said, so it needs an owner question rather than a verdict on the record. Nothing in the record itself adds a commitment beyond the three behaviours named in its question.
